## Episode Thesis

This episode is a policy/tax discussion about how savers who leverage (borrow against) their capital insurance (kapitalförsäkring) portfolios lost the right to interest deduction since the start of the year, while ISK savers keep it. It covers the legislative miss, the Swedish Tax Agency's literal interpretation, the Finance Ministry's disinterest, and a parliamentary majority (including the Moderates) wanting to fix it. No listed companies or equities are discussed.
